## Summary

XDHx86 is an AI quality specialist and Arabic-language evaluation expert with 4+ years of experience in model testing, localization validation, and structured data-driven quality assurance. Graduate of Youngstown State University with a BS in Computer Science (2023). Extensive hands-on background evaluating AI outputs, rating model behavior, and documenting defects across Arabic/English bilingual workflows. Combines software engineering foundation with deep expertise in systematic quality evaluation, issue categorization, and structured documentation for AI training and validation initiatives. Passionate about building reliable systems from code to production.

Interests: Backend Engineering, System Automation, AI, SaaS, Performance Optimization, Open Source.
